name: Functional Safety for Automotive AI: ISO 26262, ISO 21448 (SOTIF) and ISO/PAS 8800
description: A standards-engineering course built on one running case: a Tier 1 supplier (a fictional composite) delivering an ML pedestrian AEB camera to a US automaker against a signed development interface agreement, a safety release gate and a start-of-production date. Learners produce the HARA, the SOTIF catalog and acceptance criteria, the dataset specification, the validation exposure ledger, the target-equivalence report, the field escalation and the safety argument, and practice the trade-offs in six Decision Labs.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Transport, Logistics and Mobility

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Functional Safety for Automotive AI: ISO 26262, ISO 21448 (SOTIF) and ISO/PAS 8800

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 16 lessons in 5 modules, play each of the course's 6 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
